# Scan Perks

> A digital stamp card for independent cafes, pubs, bars, and pizzerias. The venue prints one counter QR; customers scan it in the free Scan Perks app (iPhone or Android) and collect stamps toward a reward the owner sets. A phone camera pointed at the QR opens the venue page with an app link. $10/month Starter (500 scans a month), $15/month Growth (unlimited), after a 14-day free trial with no card. No POS. Owner signup: https://app.scan-perks.com

Scan Perks is new: it does not publish venue or member counts, and it has no customer case studies yet.

Scan Perks is owner software, not a chain consumer app like Starbucks Rewards. It does not include mobile ordering. Also written ScanPerks or Scan-Perks. People sometimes search for it as "scanbucks". Founder and developer: Bekim Biçaku. Canonical host: https://scan-perks.com

## Product

- [Cafe loyalty app](https://scan-perks.com/cafe-loyalty-app/): Loyalty for independent coffee shops. Counter QR stamp card, $10/month after a 14-day free trial.
- [Coffee loyalty app](https://scan-perks.com/coffee-loyalty-app/): Same product for the query "coffee loyalty app". For cafe owners, not chain rewards.
- [Coffee shop loyalty app](https://scan-perks.com/coffee-shop-loyalty-app/): Counter QR stamps for coffee shop owners. No POS.
- [QR code loyalty program](https://scan-perks.com/qr-code-loyalty-program/): How a venue QR stamp program works. No POS, about 5 minutes.
- [How it works](https://scan-perks.com/how-it-works/): Print a QR, the customer scans it in the Scan Perks app, a stamp lands on their card.
- [Pricing](https://scan-perks.com/pricing/): $10/month Starter (500 scans a month) or $15/month Growth (unlimited). Less than Square Loyalty (~$45) or Loopy (~$49).
- [FAQ](https://scan-perks.com/faq/): Owner answers on price, whether customers need an app, and competitors.
- [Start the free trial](https://app.scan-perks.com): Owner signup and dashboard. 14-day free trial, no card, cancel anytime.

## Pubs and bars

- [Pub loyalty card](https://scan-perks.com/pub-loyalty-card/): Digital replacement for paper pub stamp cards. From $10/month (about £8).
- [Pub loyalty scheme](https://scan-perks.com/pub-loyalty-scheme/): Scheme ideas and one-day setup for UK pubs.
- [Bar loyalty programs](https://scan-perks.com/bar-loyalty-program/): For US bars. Counter QR, happy-hour double stamps, no POS.

## Comparisons

- [Best coffee loyalty programs 2026](https://scan-perks.com/blog/best-coffee-loyalty-programs/): Scan Perks ($10), Brewstamp ($7, coffee-only), Loopy (~$49), Square Loyalty (~$45), LoyaltyPass ($99).
- [Coffee shop loyalty without an app?](https://scan-perks.com/blog/best-mobile-loyalty-apps-coffee-shops-2026/): Wallet passes (no install) versus checkout loyalty versus an app with push offers.
- [Scanbucks](https://scan-perks.com/scanbucks/): Scanbucks is the same product as Scan Perks.
- [Reviews on G2](https://www.g2.com/products/scan-perks/reviews): Third-party reviews.
